topics.title_zh: Anthropic用Claude连破千禧难题引围剿，斯坦福携纯人类论文宣战
topics.title_en: Anthropic Stirs Math World with Claude Proofs as Stanford Counters with Human Draft
topics.summary_zh: Anthropic数学家Alpöge宣称利用Claude证明黎曼猜想并联手NYU修复OpenAI在纳维-斯托克斯方程上的解法漏洞。数小时内斯坦福学者紧急发布纯人类手写草案硬刚，学界就AI符号推理的真实性爆发激烈交锋。
topics.summary_en: Anthropic's Levent Alpöge claimed Claude proved the Riemann hypothesis and fixed OpenAI's Navier-Stokes blowup loophole with NYU's Tristan Buckmaster. The breakthrough sparked immediate scientific uproar as Stanford researchers countered with an all-human competing draft within hours.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 机器超智派 / 符号推理同盟
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: Anthropic研究团队与形式化验证学者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 复杂偏微分方程与数论难题正被大模型突破，AI辅助排查出人类难以察觉的代数漏洞，标志着形式化自动推理跨越奇点。
perspective_pro.point_en: AI-assisted reasoning is conquering millennium problems by catching algebraic flaws invisible to humans, marking an inflection point for automated scientific discovery.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 严谨本体派 / 人类数学家阵营
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 斯坦福数学研究组及传统分析学派
perspective_con.point_zh: 警惕科技巨头用未经验证的预印本搞公关噱头，大模型极易在百页推导中隐藏微妙幻觉，缺少严谨同行评议绝非真理。
perspective_con.point_en: Skeptics warn against corporate PR stunts, arguing LLMs camouflage hallucinated logical leaps across massive proofs that lack rigorous peer review.

topics.title_en: Amazon Eyes $7.5B Decart Acquisition as Musk Demos Engine-Free Real-Time Neural Video
topics.summary_zh: 亚马逊被曝拟以75亿美元收购AI世界模型开发商Decart以抗衡英伟达算力税；育碧同步设立Motherbrain子公司押注记忆NPC。同时马斯克与Brockman展示单芯片实时无引擎渲染视频，直接引发生成式AI终结传统游戏管线的行业震荡。
topics.summary_en: Amazon is closing in on a $7.5B deal to acquire Decart to boost cloud efficiency against Nvidia, while Ubisoft launched Motherbrain for autonomous NPCs. Simultaneously, Elon Musk showcased real-time neural world rendering with no game engine, escalating the platform battle over interactive media.

perspective_pro.point_en: Real-time neural generation renders traditional polygon engines obsolete, slashing game development cycles and unlocking infinite systemic world generation.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 传统管线派 / 工业可控质疑者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 3A游戏主治架构师与实时图形学学者

perspective_con.point_en: Engine-free video lacks determinism, exact collision physics, and editability, rendering it a high-cost generative illusion incapable of replacing structured AAA pipelines.
